reason: Re-opened packet.js veda 63 --verse 6.51.8 (rev 200162): Sāyaṇa glosses ugram as सर्वोत्कृष्टम्, तेन हि सर्वं लभ्यते (highest of all, for by it all is obtained), and says द्यावापृथिव्यौ प्राणिभिर्नमस्क्रियमाणे सत्यौ ... चिरकालमवतिष्ठेते (heaven and earth, revered by living beings, remain long); this carries both halves of the reading, and Wilson note 2 reports the scholiast the same way. day.js: 6.51.7 is the plea not to suffer for the sin of others and names the Universal Gods; the hymn introduction marks it vaiśvadeva. Key verse is the first two whole sentences of 6.51.8, verse.js ok (491,8); entry-check ok; revision 200162 dated 2019-04-24 by the Wikisource API.
